blocks.text: In 2000, Dead or Alive 2: Hardcore became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the fighting category, Dead or Alive 2: Hardcore broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
